title: Tenants
subtitle: Every customer running on this instance, what they hold and what they let you see.

support.hint: Granted by the tenant, not by you. Only their administrator can change it.

card.noAccess: This tenant has not granted you access.

fields.name: Name
fields.domainHint: How this tenant is reached. Every request on this host lands in their data.
fields.adminEmailHint: They get an invitation to set their own password.
fields.suspendedWarning: Suspended tenants cannot sign in. Their data is kept.
fields.aiLimitHint: An operational cap, per day. Uncapped, they spend against the instance licence.

create.title: New tenant
create.subtitle: Creates the tenant and invites its first administrator.

edit.title: Edit tenant
edit.subtitle: Support access is not here: only the tenant can grant it.

terminate.title: Deactivate this tenant?
terminate.body: Nobody in {{name}} will be able to sign in. Their data is kept, so this is reversible, but it takes the customer offline now.

reactivate.title: Activate this tenant?
reactivate.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again. Their preserved data is restored as-is.

deletePermanent.title: Delete this tenant forever?
deletePermanent.body: Every trace of {{name}} — users, data sources, dashboards, alerts, integrations — will be erased. This cannot be undone.

toast.noPermission: You do not have permission to do that
